title: fix(core): list the spec's disabledReason in the action key inventory
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKVhJ1oRyVCVbC7mtsggaEP)_

Fixes #26849

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:控制台的动作键清单 `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS`(`@object-ui/core`)补上 spec `ActionSchema` 新声明的 `disabledReason` 一项,附一行注释和一条测试断言。
- **为什么改**:#26786 给 spec 加了 `disabledReason` 后,这份「逐条复述 spec 声明键」的清单没跟上,main 的 Test UI 在 `actionKeys.pin.test.ts` 上一直红,并传染到每个合过 main 的 ui PR。
- **风险与回滚**:极低。只多认一个键,开发态不再把它报成未知键;`ActionDef`、运行时读取、spec 都不动。回滚即还原这一行。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts`(新增条目与注释);`ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys.pin.test.ts`(新增一行断言)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys.pin.test.ts`,预期 19 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` gains `'disabledReason'`, after `'disabled'`, with a comment of the kind `'description'` carries: the array restates the spec's declared keys, the entry follows #26786, and the key's readers ship with the console half of #26619.
- `ActionDef` is not changed and nothing in the runner reads the key. No `packages/spec/**`, server or new-key change.
- One root changeset, `@object-ui/core` patch.

## Tests

- `actionKeys.pin.test.ts` "lists every key the spec ActionSchema declares" was red on main (`missing: ['disabledReason']`, main's Test UI 9/16 at `aeb9cf0d`) and is green here.
- One line beside the existing `classifyActionKeys` case asserts that an action carrying `disabledReason` classifies with no unknown and no retired key.

## Acceptance notes

- The order's acceptance command, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core exec vitest run src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys`, runs vitest from the package directory, which `ui/scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` refuses. The run below is its `ui/`-rooted equivalent from `ui/AGENTS.md`.

## Verification

All at head `e80b8cda`, in a worktree off `origin/main` `4702c468`.

- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/core --concurrency=2` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, 4/4 tasks (type-check covers the test file).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/actionKeys.pin.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 19 passed (19)`.

</details>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock: `Test Files 178 passed | 2 skipped (180)`, `Tests 5065 passed | 2 skipped (5067)`.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` under the lock: `0 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number`.
